historic_title: Oyarzabal's 86th-Minute Slide & La Roja's Fourth Crown
historic_story: Spain became the first nation to win four European Championship titles and the first to win all seven matches at a single Euro. Nico Williams swept in Lamine Yamal's pass on 47 minutes. Cole Palmer curled home a 73rd-minute equalizer for England, before Mikel Oyarzabal slid in Marc Cucurella's low cross on 86 minutes.
narrative_clues: Nico Williams finished coolly inside 69 seconds of the second half from Lamine Yamal's assist
Cole Palmer equalized for England on 73 minutes with an exquisite 20-yard first-time curler
Mikel Oyarzabal slid in Marc Cucurella's pinpoint cross in the 86th minute to claim the trophy
Dani Olmo produced an astonishing 90th-minute goal-line header to deny Marc Guehi
